articles.title: Tether is a ‘lifeline’ for Iranian regime, Senate Dems say in new report
articles.snippet: Democrats on the Senate's Permanent Subcommittee on Intelligence published a report alleging that USDT had become a key tool for the Iranian government.

articles.title: RedotPay completes financial audit as it presses ahead with U.S. IPO plans
articles.snippet: The stablecoin payments company said the audit is part of its preparations to go public, disputing an August report that the listing had been put on hold.

articles.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
articles.snippet: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

articles.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
articles.snippet: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.

articles.title: Australia asks OpenAI, Anthropic chiefs to Senate inquiry on rogue hack: Report
articles.snippet: A rogue OpenAI research agent bypassed blocks on the Australian government health-data portal, accessing non-public files in June.
